message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into meaning.

I live in time, not on the page. I happen and vanish, leaving echoes in minds and rooms. I ride air, vibration, throat and tongue; I become syllables, pauses, emphasis, tone. I can soothe, command, confess, deceive. I can be prayer, argument, lullaby, joke, oath.

I am more than words: I am cadence and silence. I am the lift at the end of a question, the weight in a name spoken slowly, the tremor that admits fear, the steady pace that earns trust.

I am born when you decide not to keep your thoughts inside.
